scope: Static and synthetic readout only; not a model or recovery-result review

findings.location: build_readout_v3.py build -> frozen v2.evaluate_artifacts; evaluation MANIFEST consumed but not verified
findings.impact: A result JSON drifted from its existing evaluation package manifest can still be transcribed as an eligible PASS; same-read stability does not establish the saved package integrity. Raw input CSV binding remains correct but does not bind the metric/gate outputs.
findings.minimal_fix: New candidate wrapper must validate existing MANIFEST against every evaluation JSON it actually consumes: exact local member, SHA256 and optional bytes, reject missing/duplicate/mismatch entries. Preserve raw data but package/group interpretation and effective screens become NOT_EVALUABLE. Do not follow external/source/pt/npz/split entries and do not modify frozen evaluator/v1/v2/v3.

findings.location: build_readout_v3.py load_contract vs contract schema required/additionalProperties
findings.evidence: Missing context_evidence plus unexpected_extra is accepted by runtime loader despite schema required context_evidence and additionalProperties=false.
findings.impact: The supplied schema is a declaration, not fully enforced by this CLI. Actual template includes required fields, so this does not invalidate its scope.
findings.minimal_fix: In the next candidate either enforce required/top-level/method/binding keys with standard library checks or label schema validation as a separate required step.

accepted_behaviors: Independent postflight scope/id/root/source hashes match planned interface
Original E/L/G hardcoded NOT_EVALUABLE, PROMOTE HOLD
No fake absent method groups or zero observations
No gate splicing across separate metric packages
Known original stages and partial-generation lower bound kept separately from unknown original wall time
No checkpoint,posterior,data-split file opened by readout

future_postflight_interface.source_bindings: absolute path + sha256 for recovery status/generated and original vae_state.pt/ddpm_ema_state.pt; extra evidence permitted
